audience: associations that manage members, events and registrations in MemberRun

useCases.title: Check the status and expiry of members
useCases.text: List the active members, then open one member to read its status, role and expiry date.

useCases.title: See who is waitlisted for an event
useCases.text: List the events, then list the registrations of one event, filtered by status, to see who is on the waitlist.

useCases.title: Review the open invoices of a member
useCases.text: List the invoices of one member, filtered by status, then open one to read its amount, currency and due date.

useCases.title: Add a member for a new applicant
useCases.text: Create a membership for an email address, with a role and status. If the person already has a membership, the API returns HTTP 400.

useCases.title: Register a member for an event
useCases.text: Register an existing member for an event. A paid seat is refused unless the ticket was paid on another system, because the API cannot take payment.
